findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 14 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: The book prints "unit vector in the director of the vector"; it should read "in the direction of the vector".

Book correction: In the figure the book labels the point on the y-axis B(0, \gamma, 0). The point under discussion is the foot of P(x, y, z) on the y-axis, so it is B(0, y, 0); \gamma is an angle, not a coordinate. Our figure shows the correct label.
